title.rendered: I Am Loved With an Everlasting Love: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Lord said: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness. Of all the truths about who you are in Christ, this is the deepest. Every other identity rests on this one.

content.rendered:
The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.” Of all the truths about who you are in Christ, this is the deepest. Every other identity rests on this one. You are loved.

The Gospel For Today | Sunday, July 12, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: ‘I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.'”
Jeremiah 31:3 (NIV)

Today’s Message

For two weeks we have walked through the great identity statements of the New Testament. You are a new creation. You are the righteousness of God in Christ. You are seated with Christ in heavenly places. You are more than a conqueror. You are blessed with every spiritual blessing. You are chosen before the foundation of the world. You are redeemed through His blood. You are sealed with the Holy Spirit. You are free in Christ. You are hidden with Christ in God. You are complete in Christ. You are God’s workmanship. You are the temple of the Holy Spirit. Today, on the final day of this series, we arrive at the truth that all the others rest on. You are loved with an everlasting love.

Jeremiah 31:3 is one of the most beautiful verses in the entire Old Testament. The setting is harrowing. Israel has gone into exile. The temple has been destroyed. The nation has lost everything that gave its life shape. Into that ruin, the Lord speaks through the prophet Jeremiah, and the message is staggering in its tenderness. I have loved you with an everlasting love. I have drawn you with unfailing kindness. The God who could have said almost anything in that moment chose to say this. You are loved. The love does not end. The kindness does not fail.

The Hebrew word for “everlasting” is olam. It carries the sense of from time immemorial, beyond the boundaries of measured time. The love of God for His people is not a love that began at conversion. It is a love that has always been. It precedes creation. It precedes the universe. It is anchored in the eternal nature of God Himself. The God who is love has loved you forever, and will love you forever, and is loving you right now in this very sentence.

And the Hebrew word for “unfailing kindness” is hesed. It is one of the richest words in the entire Old Testament. It is the covenant-keeping, faithful, never-quitting love of God. It is the love that does not let go even when the beloved does not deserve it. It is the love that pursues, that draws, that gathers in, that brings home. Jeremiah says the Lord has drawn you with this hesed. He has not pushed you. He has not coerced you. He has drawn you, gently, by the cords of His own faithful kindness.

Every other identity truth we have explored over the past fourteen days rests on this one. You are a new creation because He loved you. You are righteous because He loved you. You are seated with Christ, sealed with the Spirit, complete in Him, hidden in God, His handiwork, His temple, because He loved you. The love is the engine. The love is the foundation. The love is the first word and the last word of who you are in Christ.

For Gospelbuzz readers, this is where the “In Christ” series ends. Not with a list of facts to memorise. With a Person to be known. The God who is love has loved you with an everlasting love. Everything else is the working out of that one truth. Walk in it today. Walk in it tomorrow. Walk in it for the rest of your life.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I am loved with an everlasting love. You have drawn me with unfailing kindness. The love that holds me has no beginning and no end. It precedes the universe and outlasts every season I will ever walk through. I am Your beloved in Christ. This is the truth that holds every other truth about who I am. I receive this love today. I rest in it. I walk in it. I let it be the foundation of every decision, every relationship, every prayer, every step. I am loved. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am loved with an everlasting love. The Lord has drawn me with unfailing kindness. His love is the foundation of who I am. I walk in His love today.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • 1 John 4:9-10: This is love: not that we loved God, but that He loved us
  • Ephesians 3:17-19: The love of Christ that surpasses knowledge
